<thought>Since the strict search returned no templates, I will broaden the criteria to only require that a ketone is broken and a five‑membered ring is formed. This should retrieve a template that matches the carbonyl‑ene cyclization.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["five-membered rings"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
